## One manual step for this update

**Please don't press "Update now" below.** A bug in 0.5.3 and earlier means it closes LocalTC without installing anything.

**[Download LocalTC-Setup.exe](https://github.com/duckiest428/LocalTC/releases/download/v0.5.5/LocalTC-Setup.exe)**, close LocalTC and run it. It installs over this version, and your settings and flights stay.

You only need to do this once. From 0.5.5, updates install from here again.

### What's new
- LocalTC now works with MSFS 2020 as well as 2024
- Controllers with accents from all over the world, and a copilot that can talk with you in six more languages
- The airport on the Live Map is back, with clearer aircraft colours
- ATC starts from the right airport, and real arrival and departure ATIS are combined
- Many more cabin crew announcements, with no ding on the interphone
